random_id.description: Generate a unique identifier to use as a reference or order number: a random UUID by default, or a short alphanumeric code for human-facing codes.
random_id.name: random_id

parameters.description: The kind of ID to generate.
parameters.name: format

returns.description: A random ID: a UUID, or for the short format, an 8-character code of capital letters and digits.

random_integer.description: Pick a random number between two numbers (no decimals).
random_integer.display_str_template: Pick a random number between {0} and {1} (no decimals)
random_integer.name: random_integer

returns.description: A random whole number between the minimum and maximum, both included.

random_real.description: Pick a random decimal number between two numbers.
random_real.display_str_template: Pick a random decimal number between {0} and {1}
random_real.name: random_real

returns.description: A random decimal number from the minimum up to, but not including, the maximum.

random_sample.description: Randomly choose items from a list, like drawing names from a hat. Each item can only be picked once.
random_sample.name: random_sample

parameters.description: The list to pick items from.
parameters.name: values

parameters.description: How many items to pick. Asking for more than the list holds gives the whole list, shuffled.
parameters.name: n

returns.description: That many items picked at random from the list, each one at most once. The whole list, shuffled, if it has fewer items.
